sloka: प्रसीद लंकेश्वर राक्षसेन्द्रलंकाम् प्रसन्नो भव साधु गच्छ ।त्वम् स्वेषु दारेषु रमस्व नित्यम्रामः स भार्यो रमताम् वनेषु ॥३-३१-४९॥
transliteration: prasīda laṁkeśvara rākṣasendralaṁkām prasanno bhava sādhu gaccha ।tvam sveṣu dāreṣu ramasva nityamrāmaḥ sa bhāryo ramatām vaneṣu ॥3-31-49॥

translations.english: O lord of Lanka, chief of the demons, be pleased to return to Lanka and enjoy yourself in the company of your wives. Let Rama enjoy with his wife in the forest.
